[2026-08-31T16:40:53.019Z] [player] Ask how far they range
[2026-08-31T16:40:53.021Z] [world] "I do this stretch and one other." They gesture vaguely. "Any more and you are travelling, not trading. Travelling is how you lose stock."
[2026-08-31T16:40:53.022Z] [world] Teska Nightweigh uses your name in the middle of it without making anything of it.
[2026-08-31T16:40:53.836Z] [player] Ask why they trade out here
[2026-08-31T16:40:53.838Z] [world] "Because out here I am the only shop in the world." The trader grins at their own arithmetic. "In a settlement I am one stall among twenty. On this stretch of road I am civilization ITSELF for half a day's walk in both directions. The mark-up is not greed, it is geography." The grin softens a notch. "Also — and do not spread this — somebody should be out here. Th
e road is long. A fire and a fair-enough price change what the road IS."
[2026-08-31T16:40:53.839Z] [world] Teska Nightweigh talks to you while doing something else, which is its own kind of trust.
